'''Agardo Saranche''' is the innkeeper of [[The Dragon]].

==Appearance==
He is a lean man who is balding. His complexion is nearly as fair as a [[Cairhien]]in. He has dark eyes.

==Activities==
When [[Rand al'Thor]] and his company, including [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]], [[Min Farshaw]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Alivia]] come to [[Tear]], they rent a room at Master Saranche's inn. When Rand only wants one room, Saranche's thoughts go to impropriety. When Rand says that he wants the largest room, and one with a view of the [[Stone of Tear|Stone]], Saranche says that all of his large rooms are taken and offers to escort them to [[The Three Moons]]. Cadsuane then reveals herself as [[Aes Sedai]] to force Saranche to give them a room, but well paid for by Rand.
